LANGUAGE.TITLE: Which language should your assistant use?
LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION: Welcome, {name}. We will use this language for the remaining setup and the assistant’s starting instructions.

OPTIONS.TR: Continue setup and prepare assistant responses in Turkish.
OPTIONS.EN: Continue setup and prepare assistant responses in English.

WEBSITE.TITLE: Where can we learn about your business?
WEBSITE.DESCRIPTION: Add your company website and we will prepare business facts and instruction suggestions in the background.
WEBSITE.LABEL: Company website
WEBSITE.HELP: We read the home page and up to nine relevant pages. You will review every suggestion before it changes the draft.
WEBSITE.ENRICHING: We are checking the company details already available to your workspace. You can continue editing this field.
WEBSITE.INVALID: Enter a public company website, such as example.com.
WEBSITE.UNREACHABLE: We could not open that website. Check the address or continue without it.
WEBSITE.REVERIFY: The website check expired or the address changed. Check it again to continue.

TONE.TITLE: How should it speak with customers?
TONE.DESCRIPTION: This sets the default style. The assistant will still adapt to the customer and situation.

CONCISE.TITLE: Concise
CONCISE.DESCRIPTION: Direct answers with minimal extra detail.

REVIEW.TITLE: Ready to create your draft
REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Review the starting choices below. You can edit the complete instructions on the next screen.
REVIEW.WEBSITE_CONFIRMATION: Make sure this is your business.

ONBOARDING_NEXT.ERROR: Could not create your assistant. Please try again.

ONBOARDING_INBOX_SETUP.GREETING: Let's set up a few things
ONBOARDING_INBOX_SETUP.SUBTITLE: This will give you head-start in your workspace
ONBOARDING_INBOX_SETUP.ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

CREATED_FOR_YOU.TITLE: We've created the following for you
